description: Delete one automation, by its id from list_automations. It cannot be undone: call it only after the user agreed, with confirm:true. Ad rules are deleted on the platform and read back; a boost automation stops making boosts (boosts it already started keep running). An alert channel is disconnected with disconnect_connector instead; the refill is switched off, not deleted. Free.

id.description: the automation id from list_automations (meta_rule:…, google_rule:…, tiktok_rule:…, boost:…, alerts:…, dm:…, refill)

name: delete_automation
title: Delete an automation
